## Summary

**Source:** a minimal fixture page with just one component — two pill-shaped CTA buttons ("Get started" / "See pricing") inside a flex container, no other content, no JS-driven sections, no images.

**Componentization:** Treated `.cta-a` and `.cta-b` as an intentional two-button CTA group (same shape, slightly different off-scale metrics), reproduced verbatim as `<a>` tags with the exact copy and hrefs (`/start`, `/pricing`).

**Off-scale tokens:** The original's values don't sit on Tailwind's default scale (colors `#017a07`/`#018008`, border-radius `33px`/`34px`, padding `9px/17px` and `10px/18px`, margin-top `14px`/`15px`), so I extended `tailwind.config` with named tokens for each (`cta-a`/`cta-b` colors, radii, and spacing keys) rather than rounding to the nearest default or hand-rolling raw CSS.

**Nothing flagged as unrecreatable** — the page is trivially small and fully static.

**Screenshot comparison:** Two rounds at 1280×900 via headless Chrome. Round 1 was already very close but was missing the browser's default link underline (since the original has no CSS reset, so anchors keep default underline decoration despite the color override). Round 2 added Tailwind's `underline` class to both links, which brought the clone to a visual match with the original.

Output written to `/var/folders/gb/m6478s0n5mx9wqlz8t_c03800000gn/T/gumshoe-agent-run-s0Vs02/clone.html`; screenshots (`original.png`, `clone-round1.png`, `clone-round2.png`) are in the same directory.
